title: Unified Edge-to-Cloud AI Acceleration on the AMD Ecosystem: Empirical Characterization of XDNA 1 NPU, RDNA 3 iGPU, Token Lab API, and Instinct MI300X
description: Reproducible, cryptographically audited research and engineering repository spanning the AMD AI hardware and software ecosystem, from local XDNA 1 NPU (Ryzen AI 1.9.0) and RDNA 3 iGPU (DirectML) on AMD Ryzen 5 8600G to AMD Token Lab hosted inference and AMD Instinct MI300X (192 GB HBM3, ROCm / HIP) datacenter compute.

creators.name: Wibisono, Ahmad Rifa'i
creators.affiliation: Department of Electrical Engineering, Universitas Muhammadiyah Prof. DR. HAMKA (UHAMKA)
